bias.en: Pullback · holding the 30-day, MACD near a cross
bias.zh: 回调 · 守住 30 日均线，MACD 接近交叉

read.en: Amazon rose 0.1% on Nov 17 to $257.89, trading $254.00–259.90. It is below the 5-day ($263.2, falling) and 10-day ($263.9), and just above the 30-day ($257.2), 100-day ($254.6) and 200-day ($244.8), all rising. MACD has been above its signal since Nov 4, above zero, histogram almost closed, near a cross; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 4 ($246.53), and RSI is 49.7.
read.zh: 亚马逊 11月17日上涨 0.1%，收于 $257.89，盘中区间 $254.00–259.90。股价位于 5 日（$263.2，下行）和 10 日均线（$263.9）下方，略高于 30 日（$257.2）、100 日（$254.6）和 200 日均线（$244.8），三者均在上行。MACD 自 11月4日起位于信号线上方，在零轴上方，柱状图几乎收拢，接近交叉；抛物线 SAR 自 11月4日起看多（$246.53），RSI 为 49.7。

read.en: The close held the 30-day for a second session; the $254.00 low dipped under the 100-day before recovering. Resistance is $258.5–260.2 (Nov 6 low, Nov 17 high, Nov 5 close), then $262.9–263.9 (5 and 10-day) and $271.5–275.3. Support is $254–257.2 (30 and 100-day, Nov 17 low), then $252.3 (Nov 5 low) and $244.8–246.5 (200-day, SAR). A close above $263.9 would target $266–271.5; below $254, $252.3.
